question.text: Balance with Brokers in F&O Margin Account is classified in Cat III AIF books as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 279-280 and 286, deposits with brokers are taken as an Asset for NAV computation, and the workbook shows Balance with Brokers - F&O Margin Account under assets in the fund's books. The Trap: Treating the broker margin balance as a liability, as equity, or as off-balance sheet contradicts the source asset/NAV treatment. Note: Anchor the answer on the asset classification of the F&O margin balance for NAV purposes.
